pages.text: A captured black hole, turned into a nuke-level explosive. It goes off bigger than a reactor collapse holding the same mass.$(br2)$(o)Exactly what it sounds like.$()

pages.title: Fueling it
pages.text: Use any block on it to feed it in: $(num)1$() mass per block, like a stabilizer, and far more for $(l:event_horizon/materials)Neutronium$(). Hoppers and pipes work too. Sneak to place blocks against it instead.$(br2)Blast radius: $(num)60$() blocks plus 1 per $(num)25$() mass ($(num)100$() at 1,000 mass), up to $(num)150$(). Use it empty-handed to read its mass and radius.

pages.title: Arming
pages.text: Light it with $(item)Flint and Steel$() (or a Fire Charge), or give it a $(thing)redstone signal$(). A $(num)30$() second fuse starts, beeping faster as it runs down.$(br2)$(good)Defuse$(): use the $(l:building/configurator)Configurator$() on it.$(br2)$(danger)Breaking or blowing up an armed bomb sets it off at once.$()

pages.title: Detonation
pages.text: For the last $(num)5$() seconds the black hole breaks out of the casing, swelling and pulling in everything within $(num)24$() blocks.$(br2)Then it collapses like a reactor: a carved crater, its $(l:safety/dark_energy_zone)loot$(), and a $(l:safety/dark_energy_zone)dark energy zone$() around it.
